steps.title: Read the subject
steps.body: `health check failed: <check>` (velexis-healthcheck), a unit failure from `velexis-alert@` (start limit hit), `security alert: …` (velexis-logreview), or an uptime monitor notice (outside the VM).
steps.expect: You know which tool sent it.

steps.title: Health check
steps.expect: The failing check, since when and its first problem.

steps.title: Unit
steps.body: `systemctl status velexis-<unit>`; `journalctl -u velexis-<unit> -n 100 -o cat | jq -cR 'fromjson? | select(.level >= 40)'`; `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<port>/health/ready | jq`.

steps.title: Fix and confirm
steps.body: Restart or fix the cause (`systemctl restart`, free disk, fix `alert.env`); after a bad deploy `sudo velexis-deploy --rollback`.
steps.expect: Within 5 minutes one `health check recovered: <check>` e-mail.

steps.title: Payment page alert
steps.body: Treat as possible compromise: compare files with `payment-page-inventory.json`, diff `/etc/caddy/Caddyfile` with `/var/lib/velexis/system/<sha>/Caddyfile`, run `aide --check`.
steps.expect: Either an explained change (re-deploy, then `--payment-pages`) or the incident response plan.
